title: clinopodium nepeta var. glandulosum
intro: Clinopodium nepeta var. glandulosum, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which work to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and promote the removal of mucus from the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents present in Wood Betony include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
